name: Treasury demo
description: Sign-in and shop flows on the bundled demo app

cases.name: Sign in loads
cases.flow:
%% suite "Treasury demo · Sign in"
flowchart TD
  n0(("http://localhost:3000/demo.html"))
  n1["/demo.html"]
  n2{{"Sign in"}}

  n0 --> n1
  n1 --> n2

cases.name: Shop loads
cases.flow:
%% suite "Treasury demo · Shop"
flowchart TD
  n0(("http://localhost:3000/shop.html"))
  n1["/shop.html"]
  n2{{"Cart"}}
  n3{{"Search"}}

  n0 --> n1
  n1 --> n2
  n2 --> n3

cases.name: Sign in and open Settings
cases.flow:
%% suite "Recorded flow"
flowchart TD
  n0(("http://localhost:3000/demo.html"))
  n1["/demo.html#/dashboard"]
  n2["/demo.html#/settings"]

  n0 -->|fill 'Email' : label = 'qa@example.com'; fill 'Password' : label = $QA_PASS; click 'Sign in' : button| n1
  n1 -->|click 'Settings' : link| n2
